facts.text: Phulay Bay describes itself as the world's first Ritz-Carlton Reserve.
facts.excerpt: As the world’s first Ritz-Carlton Reserve, Phulay Bay embodies the attributes, philosophy, and unique style and design of the Reserve brand’s pioneer.

facts.text: Each guest has a personal butler, called a Ton Hong, who can arrange bespoke experiences.
facts.excerpt: Their very own butler or “Ton Hong” can curate an exquisite array of bespoke experiences

facts.text: The villas and pavilions blur the line between indoors and outdoors and have personal pools and ocean and garden views.
facts.excerpt: private pavilions and luxury villas in Krabi, Thailand, that blur the boundaries between indoors and out, showcasing personal pools and ocean and garden views.

facts.text: The accommodations include traditional Thai design elements such as hand-painted panels.
facts.excerpt: traditional Thai design elements, including hand-painted panels.

facts.text: The villas have rainforest showers and outdoor bath facilities.
facts.excerpt: Rainforest showers and outdoor bath facilities at our villas in Krabi

facts.text: A private fine dining restaurant serves traditional Southern Thai cooking family-style, with several items presented at once.
facts.excerpt: Traditional Southern Thai cooking is contrasts with a modern, minimalist ambiance at this private fine dining restaurant in Krabi. Dishes are served family-style, per the local tradition, with several items presented at once.

facts.text: Sala Srichan offers a private dining experience lit by 2,000 candles, with a multi-course menu by the Executive Chef paired with Champagne.
facts.excerpt: Step into a romantic dreamscape at Sala Srichan, where the soft glow of 2,000 candles lights your evening.

facts.text: The spa has eleven treatment rooms, including outdoor terraces, with views of the lagoon.
facts.excerpt: Eleven treatment rooms, including outdoor terraces, frame views of the lagoon while reflecting both contemporary and traditional Thai architecture.

facts.text: The spa has a vitality pool.
facts.excerpt: A dip in the vitality pool where streams of water allow contemplative relaxation between treatments.

facts.text: A guided two-hour hike to Dragon Crest Mountain takes guests through rainforest to a summit viewpoint.
facts.excerpt: This guided two-hour trek winds through lush rainforest as wildlife stirs.

facts.text: The hotel collaborates with the Krabi Elephant House Sanctuary on a guided nature experience.
facts.excerpt: Enrich your stay with an immersive nature encounter at our hotel near Phang Nga Bay through our collaboration with the Krabi Elephant House Sanctuary.

facts.text: Guests can take long-tail boat rides to Hong Island.
facts.excerpt: Guests enjoy long-tail boat rides to Hong Island

facts.text: A cultural journey includes a long-tail boat through mangroves to the fishing village of Koh Klang, where guests can try batik painting.
facts.excerpt: Travel by long-tail boat through mangroves to Khao Kanap Nam’s limestone cliffs, then cross to Koh Klang, a traditional fishing village. Explore by tuk-tuk, meet artisans, try batik painting, and hand-crafting.

facts.text: Complimentary breakfast is available to hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Yes, complimentary breakfast is available at Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve to hotel guests during their stay.

facts.text: The closest airport is Krabi International Airport, approximately 40 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The closest airport near Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve is Krabi International Airport (KBV). KBV is located approximately 40.0 KM from the hotel.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the grounds are sprawling and perhaps more easily explored on wheels, and staff will chauffeur guests in golf carts.
facts.excerpt: The sprawling property is perhaps more easily explored on wheels, and hotel staff will happily chauffeur you in the resort's golf carts.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the beach is disappointing, with rocky shallows and a bay marred by a dredging complex.
facts.excerpt: Only the beach is disappointing: The shallows are rocky, and the bay is marred by an unsightly dredging complex.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the bathrooms have lotus-shaped sinks and outdoor tubs.
facts.excerpt: The bathrooms have lotus-shaped sinks and outdoor tubs

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the property has an infinity pool with double-loungers and coolers stocked with chilled face towels and coconut water.
facts.excerpt: an expansive infinity pool flanked by plush double-loungers and rattan-clad coolers stocked with chilled face towels and coconut water.
